cost_scope.actor_and_host: Nested detailed clocks; do not add to phase or waited-child CPU. Aggregate parallel pending wait is neither elapsed wall nor CPU.
cost_scope.comparison: One observed run per candidate and architecture, not repeated-run statistical or isolated causal attribution of the cost delta.
cost_scope.parent_cgroup: Wider parent cgroup before/after CPU includes the full five-test native group and driver. Do not add it to child CPU or call it single-confirmation CPU.
cost_scope.phase: Nested spans of the same child; phase samples exclude final report serialization. Traffic-plus-join wall can extend beyond the four-second business window.
cost_scope.rss: wait4 peak child RSS including pre-exec image; not attributable to only Rust or a single phase.
cost_scope.wait4: Whole owned child including both baseline and pressure, final Rust JSON serialization/write and exit; excludes parent Python hashing/verification/receipt writing. Numeric waited PID is not persisted in process.json; no independent numeric PID equality claim.

old_campaign_separation: Earlier 7e4b96d4 causal diagnostics are not measurement rows in this 119c versus 27d6 comparison. Earlier mutation reservation/work counts must not be substituted for 119c metrics.
result: r20: both actual pressure targets failed; r21: both actual pressure targets passed within the unchanged original window
